wc:minerva-week-strip.summary: A week of selectable days with today, markers and week navigation.
wc:minerva-week-strip.description: The seven days of a week in a row (`<WeekStrip>` of React): a horizontal `listbox` of day `option`s. Select a day by click, Enter or Space; today carries `aria-current="date"`; days can show a count badge or a dot (`markers`). Keyboard: one tab stop (roving `tabindex`), ArrowLeft / ArrowRight move by a day (into the previous / next week; RTL swaps them), Home / End jump to the ends of the week, PageUp / PageDown move by a week. `show-navigation` adds previous / next week buttons around the month of the week. User navigation updates `week` / `value` and fires `minerva-week-change` / `minerva-change`. Setting `value` also displays its week.

properties.description: Displayed week (any day of it; attribute "YYYY-MM-DD"); defaults to the week of the selected day, else of today

properties.name: firstDayOfWeek
properties.description: First day of the week: 0 = Sunday, 1 = Monday ... 6 = Saturday

properties.name: today
properties.description: The day marked as today, "YYYY-MM-DD"; defaults to the current local day

properties.name: showNavigation
properties.description: Shows previous / next week buttons around the month of the week

properties.name: previousWeekLabel
properties.description: Label of the previous-week button (default: localized)

properties.name: nextWeekLabel
properties.description: Label of the next-week button (default: localized)

properties.name: locale
properties.description: Locale of the dates (Intl.DateTimeFormat); default: the library language

properties.name: size
properties.description: Cell density: compact ("small"), default ("medium") or comfortable ("large")

properties.name: markers
properties.description: Per-day markers keyed by "YYYY-MM-DD": a number shows a count badge (99+ above 99), true shows a dot

properties.name: weekdayLabels
properties.description: Weekday names, Monday first (7 labels), whatever `first-day-of-week` is

translationResources.title: WeekStrip 周日期条
translationResources.description: 将一周七天排成一行：选择日期、一眼看到今天、标记有任务的日期，并可逐周切换。

basic.title: 基础用法
basic.description: 受控的选中日期（"YYYY-MM-DD"）。今天带有描边并标注 aria-current="date"；日期条是水平 listbox，可用方向键、Home / End 和 PageUp / PageDown 操作。

markers.title: 标记
markers.description: markers 将日期映射为数字（计数徽标，超过 99 显示 99+）或 true（圆点）。firstDayOfWeek 决定第一列；getDayLabel 自定义无障碍名称。

navigation.title: 周切换
navigation.description: showNavigation 添加上一周 / 下一周按钮以及该周所在月份。用 week / onWeekChange 控制显示的周；方向键也可跨入相邻的周。

sizes.title: 尺寸与禁用
sizes.description: 三种密度（small 尺寸下计数显示为圆点），以及禁用状态。

WeekStripProps.value: 选中的日期，"YYYY-MM-DD"（受控；与 onChange 配合使用）
WeekStripProps.defaultValue: 初始选中的日期，"YYYY-MM-DD"（非受控）
WeekStripProps.onChange: 选中日期时调用，参数为该日期（"YYYY-MM-DD"）
WeekStripProps.week: 显示的周（受控；该周任意一天；与 onWeekChange 配合使用）
WeekStripProps.defaultWeek: 初始显示的周（非受控；该周任意一天）；非受控时显示的周会跟随选中日期
WeekStripProps.onWeekChange: 切换周时调用，参数为该周第一天（本地零点）
WeekStripProps.firstDayOfWeek: 一周的第一天：0 = 周日，1 = 周一 …… 6 = 周六
WeekStripProps.today: 标记为今天的日期，"YYYY-MM-DD"（例如服务器日期或测试中的固定日期）
WeekStripProps.markers: 以 "YYYY-MM-DD" 为键的每日标记：数字显示计数徽标（超过 99 显示 99+），true 显示圆点
WeekStripProps.getDayLabel: 日期的无障碍标签；接收日期（"YYYY-MM-DD"）及其标记
WeekStripProps.showNavigation: 显示上一周 / 下一周按钮以及该周所在月份
WeekStripProps.weekdayLabels: 星期名称，从周一开始（7 个），与 firstDayOfWeek 无关
WeekStripProps.aria-label: 日期列表的无障碍标签

cssVars.--week-strip-gap: 日期单元格之间的间距
cssVars.--week-strip-day-height: 日期单元格高度（默认 3.5rem；size="small" 时 2.75rem，size="large" 时 4.5rem）
cssVars.--week-strip-radius: 日期单元格和按钮的圆角（默认 --radius-md）
cssVars.--week-strip-today-color: 标记今天的描边和数字颜色
cssVars.--week-strip-marker-color: 计数徽标的文字颜色（以及圆点颜色）
cssVars.--week-strip-nav-height: 上一周 / 下一周按钮的尺寸（默认为当前密度的小号控件高度）
